name: Parallel Cat
source:
You are doing your day to day stuff: wake up, go to school, and sleep.

But one day it's different like it was a different universe. Will you find out what is really happening?

[Edited from [url=https://slepice24.itch.io/parallel-cat]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正在做你的日常事情：起床，上学，睡觉。

但有一天，一切都不同了，就像是一个不同的宇宙。你会发现到底发生了什么吗？

[编辑自[url=https://slepice24.itch.io/parallel-cat]Itch.io[/url]]
